verdicts.reason: A is just the square design shrunk to the middle of a banner, leaving dead space on both sides. Its text is too small to read (the subline, the CTA and the NEW FLAVOR badge), the sun logo looks squashed, and the can is small. B rearranges the design into a proper two-column banner, with the can on the left and the copy on the right. Its flaws: the NEW FLAVOR badge is tiny and sits below the CTA, which breaks the reading order. The headline wraps with 'Light' on its own line, the CTA is oversized, and the decorative circle behind it is stretched into an ellipse.
